## About
Tirez2day is a tire shop and general repair garage on Rio Rancho Rd in Pomona. Daniel and his son Patrick work on everything from new tires to brakes, spark plugs and engine trouble.
Customers tell us they come back because we explain what's wrong with the car and don't overcharge. One reviewer's grandpa has been bringing his car to Daniel for a few years, and now she does too. We're rated 4.3 from 43 Google reviews.

## Services
- Tires: New tires for cars and trucks. If we don't have your size in the shop, we can order it.
- Brake service: Brake service for cars and trucks, because no part of your vehicle matters more for safety.
- Oil changes: Regular oil changes to protect your vehicle against wear and tear.
- Computer diagnostic: A thorough inspection with our computer diagnostic system to find what's going on with your car.

## FAQ
Q: What if you don't have my tires in stock?
A: We can order them. One customer said the tires for her husband's truck were there the next day.

Q: Do you do Uber driver inspections?
A: Yes. One reviewer had an Uber driver inspection done along with brakes and a tire rotation.

Q: Are payment plans available?
A: One customer mentioned we have payment plans. Give us a call and we can talk it through.
